notes: Locks per show: locked shows only get what's missing (info files, a poster, subtitle files) and nothing that's there changes; open a show to allow changes; episodes are locked only by hand; One Piece asks you first before anything. Info is only added where the MyAnimeList match is certain ("This match is right" for the rest). Your own show info: title, description, poster and episode titles for any show, also ones not on MyAnimeList. Info files take your own info, then what Plex shows today, then MyAnimeList. New: Plex and AniBox side by side (Settings → Your Plex library), a read-only check of every Plex entry against your folders.
